title: Fulbright Visiting Scholar Program - Mongolia (2027-2028)
description: A fully funded, six-to-nine-month postdoctoral research grant bringing one Mongolian scholar to a U.S. institution of their choice, run by the U.S. Department of State's Fulbright Foreign Scholarship Board and administered through the U.S. Embassy in Ulaanbaatar. Intended for highly motivated scholars holding a doctoral degree or equivalent professional training from Mongolian higher-education institutions, think tanks, or relevant government/non-government organizations, who propose postdoctoral research at a U.S. institution in their field of specialization; the specific U.S. host institution is chosen by the scholar as part of the application. The program aims to build long-term institutional linkages between Mongolian and U.S. higher education. Grantees receive round-trip international travel, a monthly maintenance stipend (Fulbright's published 2026 Visiting Scholar rates range from USD 3,611 to 4,805/month depending on the U.S. host location's cost of living), and Accident and Sickness Program for Exchanges (ASPE) health coverage. Applicants must be Mongolian citizens currently living in Mongolia, hold a doctoral degree or equivalent, have at least 10 years of full-time work experience, and demonstrate advanced English proficiency (ACTFL Advanced Low or higher).
org: U.S. Department of State (Fulbright Foreign Scholarship Board) / U.S. Embassy Ulaanbaatar
visaNote: This is a funded research fellowship, not employment; the required J-1 exchange visitor visa is arranged as part of the Fulbright grant.
